destination_type.title: Destination Type
destination_type.description: Send messages to a topic or a queue

entity_name.title: Topic or Queue Name
entity_name.description: Name of the destination topic or queue

options.tooltip: Must already exist in the Service Bus namespace — the writer does not create topics or queues.

mode.title: Message Body
mode.description: What to send as the message body

column.title: Body Column
column.description: Input column whose value becomes the message body

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: MIME type set on each message

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Number of messages sent per batch

time_to_live_seconds.title: Time To Live (Seconds)
time_to_live_seconds.description: Per-message expiration; leave blank for the queue/topic default

options.tooltip: Optional — map input columns onto Service Bus broker message properties. Leave a field blank to skip that property.

message_id_column.title: Message ID Column
message_id_column.description: Input column holding the message's unique ID

session_id_column.title: Session ID Column
session_id_column.description: Input column holding the session ID

options.tooltip: Required on the destination if it is a session-enabled queue or topic subscription.

subject_column.title: Subject Column
subject_column.description: Input column holding the message subject (label)

correlation_id_column.title: Correlation ID Column
correlation_id_column.description: Input column holding the correlation ID

partition_key_column.title: Partition Key Column
partition_key_column.description: Input column holding the partition key

options.tooltip: Only used on a partitioned entity; must match the session ID when the entity also requires sessions.

scheduled_enqueue_time_column.title: Scheduled Enqueue Time Column
scheduled_enqueue_time_column.description: Input column holding an ISO 8601 timestamp to delay delivery

application_properties_column.title: Application Properties Column
application_properties_column.description: Input column holding a JSON object of custom properties

options.tooltip: The column's value must parse as a JSON object, e.g. `{"source": "crm"}` — each key becomes a custom application property on the message.

reply_to_column.title: Reply To Column
reply_to_column.description: Input column holding the reply-to address

reply_to_session_id_column.title: Reply To Session ID Column
reply_to_session_id_column.description: Input column holding the reply-to session ID
